title: atlas.sensor.detections.v1
description: Per-lane traffic state for one signalized junction at one instant -- the twin adapter's own view (docs/design/05_communication.md section 5.2), consumed by the state writer, anomaly service, and telemetry. Shape mirrors atlas.twin.env.JunctionState/LaneState directly (queue_length, occupancy, mean_speed_mps, vehicle_count are that dataclass's own fields).

intersection_id.description: The real SUMO/TraCI trafficlight id (e.g. '42430333', 'GS_42439981') -- not the design doc's illustrative 'J###' pattern, which predates Week 2's real network choice.
